arguments.summary: A critical credential compromise incident was detected originating from external IP 185.220.101.42. The threat actor conducted reconnaissance via an Nmap scan against an internal IT asset (10.0.2.15), then leveraged compromised credentials to authenticate successfully into the domain. Despite detection and analysis confirming the breach, attempted credential revocation via IAM/PAM controls was denied due to policy or validation constraints. Immediate containment actions are pending, increasing risk exposure.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 initiated a port scan (ET SCAN Nmap SYN Scan) against internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Logged but not blocked at network level.
Successful authentication from 10.0.2.15 to domain controller (10.0.1.1) using CORP\helpdesk credentials. Likely lateral movement vector.
UEBA system flagged low-risk anomalies for user jdoe; no immediate threat detected.
SIEM correlation identified 23 suspicious logon events linked to Finance OU accounts. Pass-the-hash attack confirmed.
Attempt to revoke 23 compromised credentials via T8 (IAM/PAM) failed due to policy enforcement or lack of authorization.

        $x64_header at 0 and $beacon_config and $c2_strings
}
